en: to be (identity, origin, time, what something is)
note: ser = what or who something is (origin, job, time, material, events); estar = where it is or how it is right now. Present: soy, eres, es, somos, son; preterite: fui, fue; imperfect: era; subjunctive: sea; tú command: sé.

en: to have (helper verb); hay = there is / there are
ex_en: Is there an ATM around here?
note: "Hay" = there is/are (never "ha" in that sense); he/has/ha + participle = have done (¿ya has comido?); "hay que" + infinitive = you have to. Present: he, has, ha, hemos, han; preterite: hube, hubo (no accents); future: habré; subjunctive: haya; tú command: he.

estar = where something is or how it is right now; estar + gerund = -ing (estoy comiendo); ser = what something is. Present: estoy, estás, está, estamos, están; preterite: estuve, estuvo (no accents); subjunctive: esté.

tener que + infinitive = to have to; tener hambre/sed/frío/calor/miedo = to be hungry/thirsty/cold/hot/afraid; tengo 30 años = I'm 30. Present: tengo, tienes, tiene, tenemos, tienen; preterite: tuve, tuvo (no accents); future: tendré; tú command: ten.

ex_en: What are you going to do today?
note: Weather: hace calor / hace frío; time ago: hace dos años = two years ago. Irregular yo: hago; preterite: hice, hizo (no accents); future: haré; tú command: haz; participle: hecho.
"¿Se puede…?" = is it allowed / possible to…? Present: puedo, puedes, puede, podemos, pueden; preterite: pude, pudo (no accents); future: podré; gerund: pudiendo.

ex_en: How do you say "receipt" in Spanish?
note: "Dice que…" = he/she says that…; "¿Qué quiere decir…?" = what does … mean? Present: digo, dices, dice, decimos, dicen; preterite: dije, dijo (no accents); future: diré; tú command: di; gerund: diciendo; participle: dicho.

ex_en: I'm going downtown on the metro.
note: ir a + infinitive = going to (voy a comer); ¡Vamos! = let's go; ¡Ya voy! = coming! Present: voy, vas, va, vamos, van; preterite: fui, fue; imperfect: iba; subjunctive: vaya; tú command: ve; gerund: yendo.

ex_en: Shall we watch a movie tonight?
note: "A ver" = let's see; in Mexico ver is the normal verb for watching TV. Irregular yo: veo; imperfect: veía; participle: visto.

ex_en: Can I have two al pastor tacos?
note: "¿Me da…?" is the natural way to order or buy in Mexico; me da miedo = it scares me. Irregular yo: doy; preterite: di, dio; subjunctive: dé.

en: to know (facts, how to); to taste
ex_es: No sé dónde está la parada.
ex_en: I don't know where the stop is.
note: saber = know a fact or know how to (sé nadar); conocer = be familiar with people or places; saber a = to taste like. Irregular yo: sé; preterite: supe, supo (no accents); future: sabré; subjunctive: sepa.

ex_es: Quiero un café de olla, por favor.
ex_en: I'd like a café de olla, please.
note: "Te quiero" = I love you (friends, family, partner); "te amo" is stronger; "quisiera" = I'd like (polite). Present: quiero, quieres, quiere, queremos, quieren; preterite: quise, quiso (no accents); future: querré.

ex_en: What time does the bus arrive?
note: llegar a (not "en"): llegué a México. Spelling: llegué, llegue.

en: to pass, to happen, to spend (time); to come in
note: "¡Pásale!" / "¡Pásele!" = come in / go ahead (Mexico); "¿Qué pasó?" is also a casual hello.
deber + infinitive = must/should; "¿Cuánto le debo?" = how much do I owe you?

en: to put, to place; to turn on
ex_en: Can you put the song on again?
note: ponerse = to put on (clothes) / to become (ponerse nervioso). Irregular yo: pongo; preterite: puse, puso (no accents); future: pondré; tú command: pon; participle: puesto.

ex_en: That seems like a very good idea.
note: "Me parece que…" = I think that…; works like gustar (me parece, te parece); "¿Qué te parece?" = what do you think? Irregular yo: parezco.

en: to be located; to be left; to fit; to arrange to meet
note: quedar bien = to fit / suit; "no queda" = there's none left; quedar en = to agree on.
"Creo que no" = I don't think so. Spelling: creyó, creyendo.
"¿Quién habla?" = who's calling?

en: to carry, to take (along); to wear
note: llevar + time = to have been (llevo un año aquí); traer = bring here, llevar = take there.

ex_en: Where do I leave the key?
note: dejar de + infinitive = to stop doing; "déjame ver" = let me see.

en: to follow, to continue, to keep going
note: seguir + gerund = to keep doing (sigo estudiando). Stem change e→i: sigo, seguimos; also siguió, siguiendo; spelling: sigo, siga.
encontrarse con = to run into / meet up with. Stem change o→ue: encuentro, encontramos.

ex_es: Te llamo mañana en la tarde.

ex_en: Are you coming to the party on Saturday?
note: venir = come here (toward the speaker); ir = go there. Present: vengo, vienes, viene, venimos, vienen; preterite: vine, vino (no accents); future: vendré; tú command: ven; gerund: viniendo.

ex_en: What are you planning to do tomorrow?
note: pensar en = to think about; pensar + infinitive = to plan to. Stem change e→ie: pienso, pensamos.

en: to go out, to leave; to come out
ex_en: What time does the flight leave?
note: salir de + place; salir con = to go out with (date). Irregular yo: salgo; future: saldré; tú command: sal.

ex_en: I'll be back in five minutes.
note: volver a + infinitive = to do again (vuelvo a llamar); in Mexico regresar is more common for "come back". Stem change o→ue: vuelvo, volvemos; participle: vuelto.

"¡Vámonos!" = let's go; irse = leave (for good), salir = go out / depart. Present: voy, vas, va, vamos, van; preterite: fui, fue; imperfect: iba; subjunctive: vaya; tú command: ve; gerund: yendo; pronominal: me voy, te vas, se va, nos vamos, se van; commands vete / váyase.

ex_en: What do you want to drink?
note: In Mexico tomar is the normal word for drinking (often alcohol); also tomar un taxi / el metro.
conocer = be familiar with / meet for the first time; saber = know facts. Irregular yo: conozco.

ex_es: Vivo en Houston con mi familia.
ex_en: I live in Houston with my family.

note: "Lo siento" = I'm sorry; for how you feel use sentirse (me siento bien). Stem change e→ie: siento, sentimos; also sintió, sintiendo.
tratar de + infinitive = to try to; "se trata de" = it's about.
"¡Mira!" also opens an explanation ("look, …"); Mexican speech often clips it to "¡ira!".

ex_en: What's your name? My name is Matt.
note: Literally "what do you call yourself"; usted: ¿Cómo se llama? Pronominal: me llamo, te llamas, se llama, nos llamamos, se llaman; commands llámate / llámese.

ex_en: Let me tell you what happened.
note: "¿Qué me cuentas?" = what's new?; contar con = to count on. Stem change o→ue: cuento, contamos.

ex_es: La clase empieza a las nueve.
note: empezar a + infinitive. Stem change e→ie: empiezo, empezamos; spelling: empecé, empiece.

en: to wait; to hope; to expect
ex_en: Wait a sec for me, I'm coming.
note: esperar = wait AND hope: "espero que sí" = I hope so.

en: to look for, to search; to pick up
note: No "for" needed: busco un taxi; also "pick someone up": te busco a las ocho. Spelling: busqué, busque.

ex_en: Can you go in with a backpack?
note: Mexico says entrar a (Spain: entrar en).

ex_es: Me gustan mucho los tacos al pastor.
ex_en: I really like al pastor tacos.
note: Backwards from English: the thing liked is the subject. Me gusta + one thing / infinitive, me gustan + plural; you mostly need gusta and gustan.
Participle: escrito.

en: to lose; to miss (a bus, a flight)
ex_es: Perdí el camión de las ocho.
ex_en: I missed the eight o'clock bus.
note: perderse = to get lost. Stem change e→ie: pierdo, perdemos.

ex_en: Michoacán produces a lot of avocado.
note: Like all -ducir verbs (conducir, traducir, reducir). Irregular yo: produzco; preterite: produje, produjo (no accents).

ex_es: Me quedo tres noches en el hotel.
ex_en: I'm staying three nights at the hotel.
note: quedarse con = to keep. Pronominal: me quedo, te quedas, se queda, nos quedamos, se quedan; commands quédate / quédese.
"Se me ocurre…" = it occurs to me / I've got an idea.

ex_en: I don't understand, could you repeat it?
note: Stem change e→ie: entiendo, entendemos.

en: to ask for, to order, to request
note: pedir = ask FOR something / order food; preguntar = ask a question. Stem change e→i: pido, pedimos; also pidió, pidiendo.
In conversation acordarse de is more common (¿te acuerdas?). Stem change o→ue: recuerdo, recordamos.

ex_en: What time does the concert end?

note: "¿Me permite?" = excuse me, may I?
Irregular yo: aparezco.

en: to get, to obtain; to manage to
ex_en: Where can I get tickets for the game?
note: Stem change e→i: consigo, conseguimos; also consiguió, consiguiendo; spelling: consigo, consiga.

ex_es: La función comienza a las siete.
note: Same as empezar, slightly more formal. Stem change e→ie: comienzo, comenzamos; spelling: comencé, comience.

en: to serve; to work, to be useful
note: "¿Para qué sirve?" = what's it for?; "¿En qué le puedo servir?" = how can I help you? Stem change e→i: sirvo, servimos; also sirvió, sirviendo.

en: to take out; to get (money, a photo, a grade)
ex_es: Voy a sacar dinero del cajero.
ex_en: I'm going to get money from the ATM.
note: sacar una foto = to take a photo. Spelling: saqué, saque.
In Mexico you'll also hear ocupar for "need" (¿ocupas algo?).

en: to keep, to maintain; to support (financially)
note: Conjugates like tener. Present: mantengo, mantienes, mantiene, mantenemos, mantienen; preterite: mantuve, mantuvo (no accents); future: mantendré; tú command: mantén.

ex_en: It turned out to be very easy.

ex_es: Leo el periódico en la mañana.
ex_en: I read the paper in the morning.
note: Spelling: leyó, leyendo.

ex_es: Tu hermano me cae muy bien.
note: caer bien/mal = to like/dislike someone (works like gustar). Irregular yo: caigo.
cambiarse = to change clothes.

ex_en: You have to create an account.

note: Participle: abierto.
"¡Ayuda!" = Help!; ayudar a + infinitive.

ex_en: Can you hear me? It sounds really bad.
note: "¡Oye!" = hey! / listen!; "¡Oiga!" (usted) to get a stranger's attention. Present: oigo, oyes, oye, oímos, oyen.

en: to finish; acabar de = to have just
ex_en: I've just arrived at the hotel.
note: acabar de + infinitive = to have just done; "se acabó" = it's over / it ran out.

ex_en: I want to convert pesos to dollars.
note: convertirse en = to become. Stem change e→ie: convierto, convertimos; also convirtió, convirtiendo.
ganas (noun) = desire: tengo ganas de… = I feel like….

ex_en: Could you bring us the check, please?
note: traer = bring here; llevar = take there. Irregular yo: traigo; preterite: traje, trajo (no accents).

en: to cut, to split; to leave
note: "a partir de" = starting from.

ex_es: Mi abuelo murió el año pasado.
note: "Me muero de hambre" = I'm starving. Stem change o→ue: muero, morimos; also murió, muriendo; participle: muerto.

en: to carry out, to do (NOT "to realize")
note: False friend! "to realize" = darse cuenta. Spelling: realicé, realice.
"Se supone que…" = it's supposed to / supposedly; conjugates like poner. Irregular yo: supongo; preterite: supuse, supuso (no accents); future: supondré; tú command: supón; participle: supuesto.
Same as entender, slightly more formal.

ex_en: Can you explain it to me again?
note: Spelling: expliqué, explique.

ex_es: Le voy a preguntar al mesero.
ex_en: I'm going to ask the waiter.
note: preguntar = ask a question; pedir = ask for / order.

en: to touch; to play (music); to be someone's turn
ex_en: Whose turn is it to pay?
note: tocar la guitarra = play the guitar (jugar is for games and sports); "me toca" = it's my turn. Spelling: toqué, toque.

ex_en: I didn't recognize you with glasses.
note: Irregular yo: reconozco.

ex_en: I'm studying Spanish for my trip.

en: to reach; to be enough; to catch up with
note: "No alcanzo" = I can't reach. Spelling: alcancé, alcance.
Irregular yo: nazco.

en: to direct, to manage, to run
note: Spelling: dirijo, dirija.

ex_es: Corro en el parque los domingos.
ex_en: I run in the park on Sundays.
note: Mexico: correr a alguien = to fire someone / kick someone out.
More formal than usar. Spelling: utilicé, utilice.
No "for": pagar la comida = to pay for the meal. Spelling: pagué, pague.
The only u→ue verb; for instruments use tocar. Stem change u→ue: juego, jugamos; spelling: jugué, juegue.

ex_en: I listen to music on the metro.
note: No "to": escucho la radio.
Stem change e→ie: siento, sentimos; also sintió, sintiendo; pronominal: me siento, te sientes, se siente, nos sentimos, se sienten; commands siéntete / siéntase.

en: to fulfil, to keep (a promise); to turn (an age)
note: cumplir años = to have a birthday.

ex_en: Can I offer you something to drink?
note: Irregular yo: ofrezco.

ex_en: We discovered a really nice café.
note: Participle: descubierto.

ex_en: Raise your hand if you know.

note: This is "to realize" (realizar is a false friend); darse cuenta de algo. Irregular yo: doy; preterite: di, dio; subjunctive: dé; pronominal: me doy cuenta, te das cuenta, se da cuenta, nos damos cuenta, se dan cuenta; commands date cuenta / dese cuenta.

ex_en: Do you use Uber or taxis?

ex_es: Olvidé mi pasaporte en el hotel.
ex_en: I forgot my passport at the hotel.
note: Very common: "se me olvidó" = I forgot (it slipped my mind).
Stem change e→i: repito, repetimos; also repitió, repitiendo.
In Mexico "la comida" is the main meal (about 2–4 pm), so comer often means have lunch.
"Vale la pena" = it's worth it; "¡vale!" for OK is Spain—Mexico says "va", "sale", "órale". Irregular yo: valgo; future: valdré.

ex_en: Could you show me the menu?
note: Stem change o→ue: muestro, mostramos.

en: to occupy, to take up; to need (Mexico)
ex_en: Do you need anything from the store?
note: Colloquial Mexico: ocupar = necesitar (ocupo un baño); "ocupado" = busy / occupied.
moverse = to move (yourself); mudarse = to move house. Stem change o→ue: muevo, movemos.
Accent: continúo, continúas (but continuamos).
More formal than pasar.
Stem change e→ie: refiero, referimos; also refirió, refiriendo; pronominal: me refiero, te refieres, se refiere, nos referimos, se refieren; commands refiérete / refiérase.

ex_en: Come closer, I can't hear you.
note: Spelling: acerqué, acerque; pronominal: me acerco, te acercas, se acerca, nos acercamos, se acercan; commands acércate / acérquese.

ex_en: I want to learn to dance salsa.
note: aprender a + infinitive.

ex_en: Where did you buy that T-shirt?

en: to go up; to get on; to upload
ex_es: Súbete al camión, ya se va.
ex_en: Get on the bus, it's leaving.
note: subir(se) al metro / al camión = to get on; subir fotos = to post photos.

ex_es: Evita el tráfico de la tarde.

note: Works like gustar: me interesa(n).
Stem change e→ie: cierro, cerramos.

en: to throw, to toss; to put in
note: "Échale ganas" = go for it / try hard (very Mexican); echar a perder = to spoil.

ex_en: I suffer a lot in the heat.

note: Works like gustar: no importa = it doesn't matter; "¿le importa si…?" = do you mind if…?

ex_en: I got the visa without a problem.
note: Conjugates like tener. Present: obtengo, obtienes, obtiene, obtenemos, obtienen; preterite: obtuve, obtuvo (no accents); future: obtendré; tú command: obtén.

ex_en: Can you show me where the exit is?
note: Spelling: indiqué, indique.
Also imaginarse.

ex_en: I usually have dinner at nine.
note: Always followed by an infinitive; no future in use. Stem change o→ue: suelo, solemos.
detenerse = to stop (yourself); conjugates like tener. Present: detengo, detienes, detiene, detenemos, detienen; preterite: detuve, detuvo (no accents); future: detendré; tú command: detén.

ex_en: Point at the one you want.

ex_es: El barrio se convirtió en zona turística.
ex_en: The neighborhood became a tourist area.
note: convertirse en + noun. Stem change e→ie: convierto, convertimos; also convirtió, convirtiendo; pronominal: me convierto, te conviertes, se convierte, nos convertimos, se convierten; commands conviértete / conviértase.
Stem change e→i: elijo, elegimos; also eligió, eligiendo; spelling: elijo, elija.

ex_es: Mi suegra prepara unos chilaquiles buenísimos.

note: Conjugates like poner. Irregular yo: propongo; preterite: propuse, propuso (no accents); future: propondré; tú command: propón; participle: propuesto.
Stem change o→ue: demuestro, demostramos.
Also "¿Qué quiere decir…?". Spelling: signifiqué, signifique.
Works like gustar; "falta poco" = almost there.

ex_en: Shall I walk you to the stop?
What would you like, young man?
note: "¿Qué desea?" = what can I get you? (shops); te deseo suerte = I wish you luck.

ex_en: Will you teach me to make tortillas?
note: enseñar a + infinitive; also "show": ¿me enseña ese?
Adds y: construyo, construyó, construyendo.
"Se vende" = for sale.
Irregular yo: desaparezco.
"¿Mande?" = pardon? / yes? (polite Mexican reply when called or when you didn't catch something).

en: to walk, to go around; to be (colloquial)
note: Mexico: andar = to be / go around (ando cansado); "¡Ándale!" = come on / that's it / hurry. Preterite: anduve, anduvo (no accents).

en: to keep, to save, to put away
ex_es: Guarda tu cartera en la bolsa.
ex_en: Put your wallet away in your bag.
note: guardar un archivo = to save a file.

ex_es: Voy a aplicar para el trabajo.
ex_en: I'm going to apply for the job.
note: Spelling: apliqué, aplique.
Irregular yo: establezco.
Formal; everyday is quedarse. Irregular yo: permanezco.
Stem change e→ie: defiendo, defendemos.
Conjugates like tener. Present: sostengo, sostienes, sostiene, sostenemos, sostienen; preterite: sostuve, sostuvo (no accents); future: sostendré; tú command: sostén.
depender de.

ex_es: El sol me provoca dolor de cabeza.
ex_en: The sun gives me a headache.
note: Spelling: provoqué, provoque.

ex_en: When do they deliver the package?
note: Spelling: entregué, entregue.

ex_en: I'd prefer a window seat, please.
note: Stem change e→ie: prefiero, preferimos; also prefirió, prefiriendo.
Conjugates like tener. Present: contengo, contienes, contiene, contenemos, contienen; preterite: contuve, contuvo (no accents); future: contendré; tú command: contén.

ex_en: The rain kept us from going out.
note: Stem change e→i: impido, impedimos; also impidió, impidiendo.

ex_en: Who does this suitcase belong to?
note: Irregular yo: pertenezco.

en: to overcome, to get over; to exceed

note: Spelling: coloqué, coloque.
Participle: descrito.
Stem change o→ue: resuelvo, resolvemos; participle: resuelto.
Participle: cubierto.

en: to return, to come back, to go back
note: In Mexico more common than volver; also "to give back": regrésame mi pluma.

ex_en: I grew up in a small town.
note: Irregular yo: crezco.

en: to go down; to get off; to lower; to download
ex_en: Are you getting off at the next one?
note: bajar(se) del camión = to get off the bus; bajar una app = to download an app.
preocuparse por = to worry about. Pronominal: me preocupo, te preocupas, se preocupa, nos preocupamos, se preocupan; commands preocúpate / preocúpese.

acordarse de + thing; more conversational than recordar. Stem change o→ue: acuerdo, acordamos; pronominal: me acuerdo, te acuerdas, se acuerda, nos acordamos, se acuerdan; commands acuérdate / acuérdese.
Adds y: incluyo, incluyó, incluyendo.

ex_en: Put on a jacket, it's cold.
note: ponerse + adjective = to become (ponerse rojo, ponerse nervioso). Irregular yo: pongo; preterite: puse, puso (no accents); future: pondré; tú command: pon; participle: puesto; pronominal: me pongo, te pones, se pone, nos ponemos, se ponen; commands ponte / póngase.
meterse = to get into / to meddle (no te metas).
"¡Fíjate que…!" = guess what… (Mexico, starting a story). Pronominal: me fijo, te fijas, se fija, nos fijamos, se fijan; commands fíjate / fíjese.

ex_en: He says he didn't see it.

en: to assure; to insure; to secure
note: asegurarse de = to make sure.
"Me cuesta trabajo" = it's hard for me. Stem change o→ue: cuesto, costamos.

en: to do for a living; to devote oneself
ex_en: What do you do for a living?
note: The natural way to ask someone's job. Spelling: dediqué, dedique; pronominal: me dedico, te dedicas, se dedica, nos dedicamos, se dedican; commands dedícate / dedíquese.
dormirse = to fall asleep. Stem change o→ue: duermo, dormimos; also durmió, durmiendo.

ex_en: Do you want to take part?

en: to try, to taste; to test
note: probarse = to try on (clothes). Stem change o→ue: pruebo, probamos.

ex_en: She acts in a soap opera.
note: Accent: actúo, actúas (but actuamos).
negarse a = to refuse to. Stem change e→ie: niego, negamos; spelling: negué, niegue.

ex_en: Shall I leave out the onion?
note: "Sin cebolla, por favor" also works when ordering.
Deep / romantic love; everyday affection is "te quiero".

ex_en: Can you send it to me by email?
note: In speech mandar is more common. Accent: envío, envías (but enviamos).
Accent: reúno, reúnes (but reunimos); pronominal: me reúno, te reúnes, se reúne, nos reunimos, se reúnen; commands reúnete / reúnase.
Spelling: surjo, surja.

ex_es: Dedico una hora diaria al español.
ex_en: I spend an hour a day on Spanish.
note: dedicarse a = to do for a living. Spelling: dediqué, dedique.
Works like gustar, but stronger; "¡Encantado!" = pleased to meet you.

hacerse tonto = to play dumb; "se me hace que…" = I think that… (Mexico). Irregular yo: hago; preterite: hice, hizo (no accents); future: haré; tú command: haz; participle: hecho; pronominal: me hago, te haces, se hace, nos hacemos, se hacen; commands hazte / hágase.

en: to dial, to call; to mark; to score
ex_en: Call me when you get there.
note: Mexico: marcar = to phone someone. Spelling: marqué, marque.

ex_en: Your Spanish has improved a lot.

note: reírse de = to laugh at. Present: río, ríes, ríe, reímos, ríen; preterite: reí, rio; gerund: riendo; pronominal: me río, te ríes, se ríe, nos reímos, se ríen; commands ríete / ríase.
Spelling: lancé, lance.
Pronominal: me levanto, te levantas, se levanta, nos levantamos, se levantan; commands levántate / levántese.
"Se me cayó" = I dropped it (it fell on me). Irregular yo: caigo; pronominal: me caigo, te caes, se cae, nos caemos, se caen; commands cáete / cáigase.

ex_en: Are you driving or am I?
note: Mexico usually says manejar for driving. Irregular yo: conduzco; preterite: conduje, condujo (no accents).
Spelling: publiqué, publique.

ex_en: Where do I throw out the trash?
We're going to celebrate your birthday.
note: Mexico also says festejar.

en: to correspond, to be one's share

ex_en: You have to face the problem.
They require a passport to enter.
